# Kordran - full summary for language models

Source: https://kordran.com/
Entity: Kordran Inc.
Contact: contact@kordran.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kordran
X: https://x.com/kordran_

## Positioning

Kordran is an industrial commercial execution firm. It helps manufacturers resolve supplier pricing issues, execute commercial changes, and protect the economics of production.

The work is: establish the facts, coordinate the people involved, and drive approved actions through to measurable results. The customer retains supplier relationships and final commercial authority unless a written agreement says otherwise.

Kordran does not sell audits or reports as the product. A credit or a refund is one possible result. Other results include lower future cost, corrected commercial terms, an implemented change, a resolved dispute, or a decision that no action is justified.

Kordran is not a software product, a law firm, a customs broker, a lender, a regulated financial institution, or a turnkey procurement department.

Working principle:
- Understand the economics.
- Make the decision.
- Execute the work.

## What Kordran takes on

Initial focus is supplier commercial terms and pricing-related disputes. The public site also describes engineering-driven cost changes and commercial implementation as work Kordran can take when the issue is defined. Supplier transitions are not advertised as a mature standalone offer.

- Supplier pricing and commercial terms: increases, pass-throughs, surcharges, amendments, and negotiated terms that need investigation or implementation.
- Commercial disputes and exceptions: unexpected charges, disputed invoices, supplier claims, and unclear cost responsibility.
- Engineering-driven cost changes: commercial consequences of revisions, specification changes, ramps, and manufacturing changes.
- Commercial implementation: approved pricing, sourcing, or process changes that still have to land in purchasing, operations, and finance.

## How an engagement runs

1. Establish the issue, the decision required, the exposure, and who is responsible.
2. Investigate agreements, transactions, operational facts, and commercial assumptions.
3. Execute: coordinate stakeholders, prepare the response, support supplier discussions, and carry authorized actions through.
4. Verify what changed and what value was realized.

Sometimes the evidence supports doing nothing. Kordran should say so.

## How to start

https://kordran.com/#contact or contact@kordran.com.

The form asks for name, company, work email, the kind of issue, and a short description. Timing and estimated exposure are optional. Records come later, through a channel agreed with the customer. Spreadsheets and PDFs are enough. Nothing has to be integrated.

## Illustrations

Do not present any figure on the site as a client result, a typical outcome, or a guarantee. The site has no testimonials and no case studies.

- /supplier-pricing is a hypothetical unit-price example and an interactive chart of extra cost, a one-time recovery of that illustrated total, and later savings.
- /approach includes a hypothetical 12% supplier increase on $4.0 million of annual spend. Holding the implemented increase to 5% on unchanged volume would avoid $280,000 a year, only if the agreement is implemented and later transactions confirm it.
